propositions: The generic reads-under-sync-contention property does not subsume the original cli_show regression because seeds F3 (empty payload) and F6 (missing ticket_id) are detected only by the original test, which includes a content-completeness assertion beyond the generic shape validation
Fault seeds F5 (35s stall) and F7 (empty list emission) are detected only by the generic property, proving neither test subsumes the other and both are complementary

Reverting the actual slim-fetch-ledge fix (F1) leaves both burst tests green; only the deterministic held-lock tests (T1, T4) detect the regression, showing the burst test does not protect against the regression it is named for

The original test's primary detection value is the partial-success class (exit 0 with incomplete records), which matches Go's precedent of keeping deterministic pinned tests and deleting unreliable probabilistic storm tests

Removing the original test would decrease the mutation score by forfeiting F3/F6 detection, violating the standard criterion (Just et al. FSE 2014) that tests are safe to delete only if removal does not decrease mutation detection
